subject: Azure Partner Center: seller handshake + account tiling for Contoso
messages:
From: Mira Shah <mira.shah@microsoft.com>

Cc: 
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Contoso/Redwood — Partner Center referral + account tiling

Hi Vanessa / Karthik,

Following our partner planning sync, Contoso is ready to move into an active Partner Center referral for their Azure migration PoC. They asked for a simple seller-handshake and an account tiling so field sellers know who to engage. High level asks from Microsoft:

- Verify the Azure account/tenant mapping and primary contact at Contoso.
- Confirm which Redwood model variants and marketplace listing we plan to reference for co-sell (we recommended the "redwood-inference/latency-optimized" SKU).
- Provide a one-page mapping (account -> owning seller) and any required Partner Center metadata (reseller ID, marketplaces contact).

I copied Contoso below. Can Redwood share an initial account tiling CSV and propose a 30-minute handshake call later this week? Microsoft will create the Partner Center referral once the handshake notes and seller assignment are in place.

Thanks,
Mira
Mira Shah
Partner Channel Manager — Microsoft Azure
mira.shah@microsoft.com

Karthik and I will own the initial tiling and handshake. Quick answers up front:
- We will reference the "redwood-inference/latency-optimized" marketplace SKU for the co-sell.
- Proposed owner for the Contoso Azure tenant is Karthik (field seller) with Vanessa supporting the enterprise motion.

I attached a draft account map (v1) and a short playbook for how we plan to engage Contoso during the PoC. Karthik, can you confirm owner details and add any field seller names we should include on the Partner Center referral?

I can do a 30-min call on Thu 1/21 9–11am PT or Fri 1/22 8–12pm PT. Mira, which slot works for the Microsoft PM?

Cheers,
